name: crosswalk_esip_ai_readiness_2026-09-10
citation: ESIP Data Readiness Cluster (2023): Checklist to Examine AI-readiness for Open Environmental Datasets v.1.0. ESIP. Online resource. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.19983722.v1

scale.full: a measured leg measures exactly this property
scale.partial: a measured leg measures a public-surface proxy for it

rows.verbatim: - Link to the dataset landing page (_questions below could be automatically filled from the landing page in the future_)
rows.why: the scan resolves the product landing page and records its final URL, and A10 measures whether a data tool behind it exposes stable, directly-requestable deep links; A7 — is that URL a DECLARED persistent identifier — is in the framework and unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - The current version of the dataset
rows.why: A8 reads a machine-readable release date and a latest-vintage pointer off the surface; the dataset's own version string is not read

rows.verbatim: - Point of contact for the dataset
rows.why: point of contact is not a leg; G4 (authority metadata) is in the framework and unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - When was the dataset originally published?
rows.why: first-publication date is not distinguished from the surface's declared release date

rows.verbatim: - Is this raw data or a derived/processed data product? _Raw/Derived_
rows.why: raw-vs-derived is a lineage property; D3 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Is this observational data, simulation/model output, or synthetic data? _Observed/Modeled/Synthetic_
rows.why: observational/model/synthetic is a lineage property

rows.verbatim: - Is the data single-source or aggregated from several sources? _Single-source/Aggregated_
rows.why: single-source vs aggregated is a lineage property

rows.verbatim: - Will the dataset be updated? _Yes, it will be updated. / No, it will not be updated_
rows.why: whether a dataset WILL be updated is a commitment; A8 sees only whether a release date and a latest pointer are published now

rows.verbatim: - If the data will be updated, how often will it be updated? [choose from]
rows.why: update frequency is not published in a form any leg reads

rows.verbatim: - Will there be different stages of the update (e.g., updated with preliminary data first and
rows.why: staged/preliminary updates are revision semantics; G2 is in the framework and unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Should the new version of the dataset supersede the current version? _Yes / No / Others_
rows.why: supersession between versions is revision semantics

rows.verbatim: - Is there any documentation about the completeness of the dataset? _Yes / No_
rows.why: completeness documentation is quality metadata; B4 is in the framework and unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - How complete is the dataset compared to the expected spatial coverage?
rows.why: spatial completeness is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - How complete is the dataset compared to the expected temporal coverage?
rows.why: temporal completeness is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - Is this dataset self-consistent in that its units, data types, and parameter names
rows.why: self-consistency of units and types; B5 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Is this dataset’s units, data types, and parameter names consistent with similar data
rows.why: cross-collection consistency; B5 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Are there processes to monitor for units, data types, and parameter consistency?
rows.why: consistency monitoring is a release-process property

rows.verbatim: - Is there known bias in the dataset? _Yes / No_
rows.why: known bias is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - Have measures been taken to examine bias? _Yes / No_
rows.why: bias examination is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - Is there reported bias in the data? _No known bias / Bias found and reported / No information available_
rows.why: reported bias is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - Is there quantitative information about data resolution in space and time? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: spatial/temporal resolution is variable-level metadata; B1 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Are there published data quality procedures or reports? _Yes / No_
rows.why: B3 measures whether METHODOLOGY is linked and legible from the product surface, which is the published-procedures half of this item; the report's content is not read

rows.verbatim: - Is the provenance of the dataset tracked and documented? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: provenance tracking; D3 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Are there checksums / other checks for data integrity? Yes / No / Not applicable
rows.why: checksums are release authenticity; F6 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - What is the size of the dataset? Depending on the resource, this might be total data volume,
rows.why: A3 sees whether a whole-product download is offered, not how large it is

rows.verbatim: - Does the dataset metadata follow a community/domain standard or convention? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: A6 validates schema.org/DCAT/Croissant markup on the product page — a metadata standard on the SURFACE. A domain convention (CF, ISO 19115) inside the dataset is not read

rows.verbatim: - Is the dataset metadata machine-readable? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: machine-readable dataset metadata on the surface is precisely what A6 measures

rows.verbatim: - Does it include details on the spatial and temporal extent? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: spatial/temporal extent is read only if it is in the surface markup

rows.verbatim: - Is there a comprehensive data dictionary/codebook that describes what each element of
rows.why: data dictionary/codebook; B1 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Is the data dictionary machine-readable? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: machine-readable data dictionary; B1 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Do the parameters follow a defined standard? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: parameter standards; unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Are parameters crosswalked in an ontology or common vocabulary (e.g. NIEM)? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: ontology crosswalk of parameters; B2 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Does the dataset have a unique persistent identifier, e.g. DOI?  _Yes, [supply identifier]  / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: a persistent identifier (DOI) is A7, which the scan does not measure

rows.verbatim: - Is there contact information for subject-matter experts? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: subject-matter contact; G4 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Is there a mechanism for user feedback and suggestions? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: feedback mechanism; no leg reads it

rows.verbatim: - Are there example codes/notebooks/toolkits available showing how the data can be used? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: A2 records a documented API, which is where example notebooks usually hang; the examples themselves are not looked for

rows.verbatim: - What is the license for the data?
rows.why: D1 measures an explicit licence on the product and the API, which is this item

rows.verbatim: - Is the license standardized and machine-readable (e.g. Creative Commons)?  _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: D1's subject is a MACHINE-READABLE licence, which is this item exactly

rows.verbatim: - Has this dataset already been used in AI or ML activities? _Link to publications/reports._
rows.why: prior AI/ML use; D2 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Are there recommendations on the intended use of the data, and uses that are not
rows.why: intended-use recommendations; D2 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - What is/are the major file formats? _Pick from a list of common data formats/ “other” (choose all that apply)_
rows.why: A1 classifies the format SERVED, on the response rather than the href, which is this item

rows.verbatim: - Is this format machine-readable? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: machine-readability of the served format is A1

rows.verbatim: - Is the data available in at least one open, non-proprietary format? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: A1's structured set is open, non-proprietary formats; PDF-only fails it

rows.verbatim: - Are there tools/services to support data format conversion? _Yes / No_
rows.why: conversion tools are not a leg; A9 sees a machine-first entry point where they usually sit

rows.verbatim: - Does data access require authentication (e.g., a registered user account)? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: A2 records the auth model where the API declares one; A12 measures whether an identified compliant client is actually SERVED, which is the enforced half of the same question

rows.verbatim: - Can the file be accessed via direct file downloading or ordering?  _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: A3 is whether a full-product download exists and is linked from the product page

rows.verbatim: - Is there an Application Programming Interface (API) or web service to access the data?
rows.why: A2 is a documented public API; A9 is the machine-first entry point

rows.verbatim: - If there is an API, does the API follow an open standard protocol (e.g., OGC)? _Yes / No_
rows.why: an open standard protocol is recorded where the API declares it; conformance is not tested

rows.verbatim: - If there is an API, is there documentation for the API? _Yes / No_
rows.why: A2's subject is a DOCUMENTED API

rows.verbatim: - Is the data available publicly via cloud services?  _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: cloud availability is usually declared in an inventory (D4) or a machine entry point (A9)

rows.verbatim: - For restricted data, have measures been taken to provide some access while still applying
rows.why: restricted-access provisions are a permissions question; D2 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Has the data been aggregated to reduce granularity?  _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: aggregation to reduce granularity is disclosure semantics

rows.verbatim: - Has the data been anonymized / de-identified? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: anonymisation is disclosure semantics; G5 unmeasured

rows.verbatim: - Is there secure access to the full dataset for authorized users?  _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: authorised-user access paths are not measured

rows.verbatim: - Have null values/gaps been filled? _Yes / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: gap filling is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - Have outliers been identified? _Yes, tagged / Yes, removed / No / Not applicable_
rows.why: outlier handling is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - Is the data gridded (regularly sampled in time and space)?
rows.why: gridding is a property of the data

rows.verbatim: - Are there associated targets or labels for supervised learning techniques (i.e., can this be
rows.why: training labels are a property of the data; nothing on the surface declares them
